papers.title: On the Safety and Efficiency of Virtual Firewall Elasticity Control
papers.review_scope: author-hosted full-text abstract, introduction, controller workflow and migration/scaling sections
papers.overlap: Virtual firewall controller for safe elastic scale-out/in, coordinated rule/state movement, correct flow update, buffer cost and resource optimization.
papers.evaluation: ClickOS/NFV-SDN prototype with CloudLab evaluation as stated in the paper.
papers.project_difference: Our candidate distinction is the exact uncertainty/carbon/risk decision rule; our two-node proxy is weaker on rule dependencies, buffering, distributed forwarding and safe scaling.
papers.remaining_review: Detailed method/metric comparison and feasibility of direct baseline reproduction; citation chain.

papers.title: Fault tolerant placement of stateful VNFs and dynamic fault recovery in cloud networks
papers.review_scope: author manuscript abstract, introduction, contributions and conclusion; publisher metadata
papers.overlap: Joint active/standby stateful VNF placement, request routing and state-transfer paths under resource constraints.
papers.evaluation: Simulation and a fault-recovery testbed with hardware and virtual switches, as reported in the manuscript.
papers.project_difference: General placement/routing/state-transfer and recovery integration already exists; exact uncertainty/carbon/risk choices need full-text comparison.
papers.remaining_review: Detailed objective, constraint, protocol and metric comparison; citation chain.

papers.title: Secure State Migration in the Data Plane
papers.venue: ACM SIGCOMM Workshop on Secure Programmable Network Infrastructure (SPIN)
papers.overlap: Authenticated state movement in a programmable data plane using a protocol designed for integrity and sender authenticity.
papers.evaluation: P4 bmv2 prototype and initial overhead evaluation reported in the paper.
papers.project_difference: Our policy hash-equivalence check is not authenticated state transfer and does not make P4Sync's guarantee.
papers.remaining_review: Full protocol, threat and evaluation comparison.

papers.title: OpenNF: Enabling Innovation in Network Function Control
papers.review_scope: primary manuscript introduction and design motivation
papers.overlap: Coordinated NF internal state and forwarding control; state-update races and flow movement.
papers.evaluation: Implementation with several modified network functions.
papers.project_difference: Our coarse conntrack copy does not provide equivalent consistency guarantees; uncertainty gating is the proposed integration question.
papers.remaining_review: Full mechanism and evaluation comparison; citation-chain screening.

papers.title: Probabilistic QoS-aware Placement of VNF chains at the Edge
papers.overlap: Probabilistic infrastructure behavior and security-constrained VNF placement.
papers.project_difference: Calibrated traffic intervals coupled to warm-migration actions require further comparison.
papers.remaining_review: Full text and journal version; no absence-of-feature claim.

papers.title: AI-Empowered VNF Migration as a Cost-Loss-Effective Solution for Network Resilience
papers.overlap: Stateful VNF migration balancing operations cost and outage loss.
papers.project_difference: Our contextual threshold is a particular rule, not novel cost-benefit reasoning.
papers.remaining_review: Detailed cost model, evaluation and citation-chain comparison.

papers.title: ESSO: An Energy Smart Service Function Chain Orchestrator
papers.overlap: Renewable-energy-aware service-chain relocation and brown-energy reduction.
papers.evaluation: Trace-driven simulation on ISP topologies, as stated in abstract.
papers.project_difference: Our modeled scores do not establish physical emissions savings.
papers.remaining_review: Publisher metadata and detailed energy/migration model comparison.

papers.title: Correctness of Flow Migration Across Network Function Instances
papers.venue: arXiv preprint; later Computer Communications version requires final citation check
papers.review_scope: primary full-text HTML abstract, mechanism and correctness sections
papers.overlap: Defines Weak-O correctness and a stateful flow-migration algorithm that does not buffer or drop packets under its assumptions.
papers.evaluation: Reports comparable TCP goodput for tested path-delay and bandwidth relationships.
papers.project_difference: Our coarse conntrack copying has no corresponding Weak-O or no-drop proof; source pinning is a separate conservative mode.
papers.remaining_review: Detailed assumption and experimental topology comparison; citation chain.

papers.title: Online Service Function Chain Placement for Cost-Effectiveness and Network Congestion Control
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computers, online 2020; volume 71 issue 1 in 2022
papers.review_scope: primary author manuscript metadata/abstract and publisher abstract
papers.overlap: Joint VNF placement/routing under fluctuating demand, migration cost and prediction errors.
papers.evaluation: Simulation comparison with online candidate-path selection, according to the publisher abstract.
papers.project_difference: Prediction error and migration cost are prior art; any claim must concern the specific tested uncertainty and invariant control loop.
papers.remaining_review: Read full method and compare prediction-error handling quantitatively.

papers.title: Moving Target Defense for Virtual Network Functions
papers.review_scope: primary author-hosted full manuscript introduction and active/passive migration design
papers.overlap: Security-motivated VNF state migration with active/passive replicas and switch-over for moving-target defense.
papers.evaluation: Experimental VNF-defense and migration comparisons are reported in the manuscript.
papers.project_difference: Risk-aware state movement itself is established; our testable question is whether traffic uncertainty and hard invariants improve a firewall controller under declared conditions.
papers.remaining_review: Detailed state consistency and threat-model comparison.
